Nordson.why: Its Advanced Technology Solutions segment sells dispensing and X-ray / optical inspection systems used in semiconductor packaging; AI-driven packaging demand lifted ATS sales 28% to a record
Nordson.evidence: Nordson Q3 FY2026 (08-20-2026): CEO - X-ray and optical inspection 'technologies are critical in ensuring semiconductor packaging'; ATS growth 'reflecting the continued strength in semiconductor'

players.product: Precision fluid dispensing systems (underfill / encapsulant) and X-ray / optical test and inspection systems for semiconductor packaging (Advanced Technology Solutions)

quarterly_data.signal: Record Q3 sales of $818 million, up 10% from $742 million, with 12% organic growth; EBITDA a record $262 million (32% of sales); adjusted EPS a record $3.25, up 19% (CEO / CFO).

Advanced Technology Solutions sales were an all-time record $220 million, up 28% (31% organically), with growth in both electronics dispense and Test & Inspection reflecting continued strength in semiconductor and electronics demand; EBITDA a record $66 million (30% of sales), up 58% (CFO). CEO: a good inflection point for the X-ray and optical businesses, technologies critical in ensuring semiconductor packaging.

CEO: backlog up 35% year-over-year entering Q4, with particular strength in Advanced Technology Solutions and Medical and Fluid Solutions; CFO: the backlog generally turns over in about six months, orders are being taken into 2027, and there is no elongation in lead times.

Full-year FY2026 guidance raised: sales of $3 billion and $35 million to $3 billion and $75 million, adjusted EPS $11.80-$12 per diluted share; CFO: ATS and Medical and Fluid Solutions order momentum drove the raise.
quarterly_data.figure: sales $3 billion and $35 million to $3 billion and $75 million; EPS $11.80-$12

quarterly_data.signal: CEO: ATS is at the peak of the cycle with legs; next year it expects to build off this all-time peak at a rate more in line with its longer-term mid-single digit number, with demand looking strong into 2027; a significant portion of current demand is in Asia, and North American chip manufacturing infrastructure investment has not yet shown up in Nordson orders.

Medical and Fluid Solutions sales were a record $231 million (+5%, about 11% organic), helped by EFD electronics demand; Industrial Precision Solutions sales $367 million (+5%); free cash flow $237 million (CFO).
